## Summary

Savindu Thathsara is an AI & Automation Engineer based in London. He builds practical automation and modern web systems. He is studying BSc (Hons) Computing with Artificial Intelligence Technology at Northumbria University, London, while applying AI and automation to real business operations.

Over 7 years he delivered React, Next.js, Vue, and WordPress systems, then deepened into AWS (EC2, S3, CloudFront, Route 53), CI/CD, GitHub Actions, Docker, workflow automation (Make.com), Python automation, and OpenAI integrations.

## Current role

Notable builds:
- Dealership lead automation: Gmail → Google Sheets via Make.com so Autotrader leads are logged automatically
- Internal staff management platform: React + Supabase (attendance, payroll from attendance, RBAC, Google Sheets sync)

## Flagship project — FarmSense AI

BSc final-year dissertation (LD6053, Northumbria University London).

Intelligent crop planning for smallholder farmers: soil ML (Random Forest), LSTM weather & market price forecasting, BERT social demand signals, XGBoost profit ranking. Stack: React, FastAPI, PostgreSQL, Docker, scikit-learn.

Repository: https://github.com/BLSThathsara20/farmsense-ai
